subject: [PATCH v9 19/32] mm: handle soft-dirty and uffd-wp on PMD swap entries

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch updates the handling of soft-dirty and uffd-wp flags in PMD swap entries to ensure they are correctly updated during migration and other operations. The changes involve adding checks for PMD swap entries in various functions that manipulate these flags, ensuring that they are treated similarly to migration entries. This fixes issues where clearing soft-dirty could skip swapped-out THPs, UFFDIO_WRITEPROTECT did not arm the flag, and mremap did not mark the destination correctly.
